overview: Tapovanam Realty Services is a mobile-first real estate catalog app for property management and customer presentation. Features open access property CRUD, interactive maps, construction site tracking, and builder partner showcase.
features: Open access property management — add, edit, delete without login
Dealer profile with Shubham Sharma's professional details
WhatsApp integration on every property card
Construction Sites category with progress tracking
Authorised Builder Partners section with verified badges
Leaflet.js interactive maps with live location
3D tilt property cards with glassmorphism modals
Dark mode and Hindi/English language toggle
